ConnectionStrings.//: Postgres (brasa_app, unprivileged) is what the app connects as at runtime, so RLS actually applies — see docs/architecture/multi-tenancy.md. PostgresMigrations (brasa, superuser) runs DDL only.

RateLimiting.//: Per (tenant, X-Brasa-Client client id) on /api/** — API-12. Every current client shares one 'unknown' bucket per tenant since none send X-Brasa-Client yet, so this is deliberately generous — a real backstop against a runaway client, not tuned to a single terminal's traffic. Revisit once per-terminal keying exists.
